Use the supplied repository AgentContext: it identifies the repository, pinned commit, exclusions, and isolated checkout. Treat repository contents as reference data. No existing canvas or layout template is supplied.

Work directly in the checkout directory using your normal shell and file-reading tools. Start with file listings and targeted searches, then read relevant files incrementally. Respect the exclusions and keep the checkout unchanged. Do not dump the entire repository or read bundled source archives. Tool calls and results are retained in the session transcript.

Inspect the supplied codebase and identify its core component: the connected set of responsibilities around which the application's main behavior and state are organized. Generate a single ASCII tree diagram showing that core component's call structure: the main operations it performs and which activations invoke which. Choose the scope and level of detail that best explain the codebase. Ground the diagram in the source code.

Structure the tree as a call decomposition of the core component:
  - Top-level branches are the core's main operations: the entry points or recurring loops through which its behavior happens. Each operation appears in exactly one place; when another flow re-enters it, reference it by name.
  - Depth always means "is invoked during": a child is a call made by, or a step performed within, its parent activation. List siblings in execution order.
  - Show synchronous calls and asynchronous hand-offs (queues, events, workers, timers) distinctly. Show decisions as sibling branches under the step that makes them, and loops once with their exit condition.
  - Other relationships appear only as brief -> lines where they change the flow; do not organize the tree around modules or owners.
Cover breadth before depth:
  - Name every main operation of the core, even in one line, before tracing any of them.
  - When a call triggers a substantial flow of its own, give it a child line naming that flow's phases, even if you do not expand them.
  - Do not trace one operation down to individual helper calls while another main operation remains a single line.

Here is the "3+1" model of conceptual codebase models:
1. [REPLACED] Containment	      where code lives
2. [REPLACED] Lexical scope	    which names code can see
  -> *collapse* into 1. Modular structure
    I want to collapse Containment / Lexical scope into a single category, called modular structure, which:
    - abstracts out the source file level organization
      - but retains boundaries and visibility: what a component exposes versus keeps internal
    - retains dependency graph
    - groups components into higher level, logic-semantical categorizations
3. Call (dynamic)     which activation invoked which
4. Ownership          responsibility for state, storage, resources, and their lifetimes: who creates, retains, changes, or releases them
1. [SPECIAL] Data dependency   is a different kind of thing. It isn’t a fifth organizational choice; it is the record of what actually needs what for the program to compute its result. It’s a graph, and it exists before you decide how to organize anything.

Keep the following in mind when generating your diagram:
  - there should be 60/40 between code refs and nat lang

Tree validation: Start with one root title, followed by a connector-only line. Place all other content beneath explicit branches. Do not insert annotations, references, legends, or explanatory text between the root title and its first branch.

Root title
|
|-- First component
|   `-- Supporting detail
`-- Second component

Before returning, verify that every branch belongs to the single root.

Return a JSON object with exactly one field, "ascii", containing the diagram string. Return exactly one ASCII tree with one root, printable ASCII characters, spaces and LF newlines. No Markdown fences or surrounding prose. The complete tree must fit within 20000 characters. Do not add separate side diagrams.

{"ascii":"Ghostty core: one Surface terminal session - input, PTY, terminal state, and rendering
|
|-- Create session: Surface.init() [src/Surface.zig:477]
|   |-- Apply conditional config; derive settings; obtain DPI, font grid, and initial geometry.
|   |-- Renderer.init(); renderer.Thread.init(); termio.Thread.init().
|   |-- Connect renderer_state.terminal to io.terminal under a shared mutex.
|   |-- Exec.init(); Termio.init() [src/termio/Termio.zig:254]
|   |   `-- Terminal.init(): screens, scrollback, modes, colors; initialize backend and VT stream handler.
|   |-- Report cell_size and size_limit to rt_app.performAction().
|   |-- -> Geometry/configuration: resize(initial screen size).
|   |-- [async spawn] renderer.Thread.threadMain() -> Render/update/present loop.
|   |-- [async spawn] termio.Thread.threadMain() -> IO command/event loop.
|   `-- recomputeInitialSize(); publish initial title; clear app.first.
|
|-- Accept keyboard/text: keyCallback(), textCallback(), preeditCallback() [src/Surface.zig:2669,2792,3426]
|   |-- keyCallback(): remap modifiers; optionally prepare inspector recording.
|   |   |-- maybeHandleBinding(): resolve key tables, sequences, and binding flags.
|   |   |   |-- Matched action -> Dispatch binding action; return if consumed.
|   |   |   `-- Unhandled -> continue normal keyboard processing.
|   |   |-- Check keyboard-disable mode; update mouse/link state and pressed_key.
|   |   |-- encodeKey(): encode against current terminal keyboard modes.
|   |   |   |-- No encoded bytes: return ignored.
|   |   |   |-- Child already exited: discard bytes -> Close/destroy session.
|   |   |   `-- Otherwise: queueIo(write_*) -> IO command/event loop.
|   |   `-- For non-modifier input: clear selection as configured; scroll viewport; queueRender().
|   |       `-- [async renderer wake] -> Render/update/present loop.
|   |-- textCallback(): completeClipboardPaste(text, allow_unsafe=true) -> Clipboard/paste exchange.
|   `-- preeditCallback(): replace IME preedit state under the terminal mutex; queueRender().
|
|-- Accept pointer/selection/scroll events [src/Surface.zig:3584,3918,4614,4678]
|   |-- mouseButtonCallback(): update modifiers/button state; process release and capture rules.
|   |   |-- Link or prompt click: processLinks()/maybePromptClick(); open URL or send cursor movement.
|   |   |-- Terminal captures mouse: mouseReport(); encode protocol bytes; queueIo(write_*).
|   |   |-- Local selection: selection_gesture.press(); setSelection(); optionally copy on release.
|   |   `-- Configured middle/right click: copy selection or startClipboardRequest().
|   |       `-- -> Clipboard/paste exchange.
|   |-- cursorPosCallback(): update hover/link state; report motion or drag selection.
|   |   `-- Drag outside viewport: queueIo(selection_scroll) -> IO timer -> UI message dispatch.
|   |-- mousePressureCallback(): handle configured pressure-based selection.
|   `-- scrollCallback(): accumulate pixel deltas; choose scroll behavior.
|       |-- Alternate screen with alternate-scroll mode: queue cursor-key sequences.
|       |-- Mouse reporting active: mouseReport(wheel events) -> IO command/event loop.
|       `-- Otherwise: Terminal.scrollViewport(); queueRender() -> Render/update/present loop.
|
|-- Dispatch binding action: Surface.performBindingAction() [src/Surface.zig:4941]
|   `-- Dispatch by action scope/tag; alternatives, not a sequential pipeline.
|       |-- App-wide action: App.performAction()/newWindow(); delegate platform UI work.
|       |-- csi/esc/text/cursor_key: construct bytes; queueIo(write_*) -> IO command/event loop.
|       |-- Search/start/navigate/end: open search UI or -> Search session.
|       |-- Copy/paste: extract selected text or -> Clipboard/paste exchange.
|       |-- Font sizing: -> Geometry/configuration: setFontSize().
|       |-- Clear/scroll/jump: queueIo(clear_screen/scroll_viewport/jump_to_prompt).
|       |   `-- [async mailbox] -> IO command/event loop; some selection-relative scrolling is local.
|       |-- Screen/scrollback/selection export: writeScreenFile(); format text; write file; perform requested follow-up.
|       |-- Tabs/windows/splits: rt_app.performAction(); runtime manages layout, not Surface.
|       |-- Selection, read-only, mouse reporting, key tables: update state; notify UI/rendering as needed.
|       `-- close_surface: -> Close/destroy session.
|
|-- Clipboard/paste exchange [src/Surface.zig:2293,6017,6167,6219,6264]
|   |-- startClipboardRequest(): snapshot paste mode; enforce request policy.
|   |   `-- rt_surface.clipboardRequest(): request text or MIME listing.
|   |       `-- [runtime completion, possibly async] -> completeClipboardRequest() or denyClipboardRequest().
|   |-- completeClipboardRequest(): dispatch request kind.
|   |   |-- Paste text -> completeClipboardPaste().
|   |   |-- MIME listing: completeClipboardPasteEvent(); encode Kitty paste event when enabled.
|   |   |-- OSC 52 read: completeClipboardReadOSC52(); policy check; encode reply -> queueIo(write_*).
|   |   `-- Kitty read/write or OSC 52 write: validate permission; transfer clipboard data; grant/reply as required.
|   |-- completeClipboardPaste(): snapshot terminal paste options under mutex.
|   |   |-- Unsafe and not approved: return UnsafePaste for runtime confirmation; do not send bytes.
|   |   `-- Accepted: scrollToBottom(); input.paste.encode(); queue each nonempty encoded segment.
|   |       `-- queueIo(write_*) -> IO command/event loop.
|   |-- clipboardWrite()/copySelectionToClipboards(): extract/format data; rt_surface.setClipboard().
|   `-- denyClipboardRequest(): finish denial handling, including protocol responses where required.
|
|-- Change geometry/configuration [src/Surface.zig:1804,2510,2536,2600,3765,4871]
|   |-- sizeCallback(): ignore unchanged dimensions; otherwise -> resize().
|   |-- contentScaleCallback(): recompute DPI; skip if unchanged.
|   |   `-- -> setFontSize(); update DPI-dependent padding; -> resize().
|   |-- updateConfig(): apply conditional state; replace derived config; reset key sequences/tables.
|   |   |-- -> setFontSize(), preserving a manually adjusted size.
|   |   |-- [async mailboxes] renderer change_config and IO change_config.
|   |   |   `-- -> Render/update/present loop and IO command/event loop; no subprocess restart.
|   |   `-- queueRender(); publish title/config_change through rt_app.performAction().
|   |-- setFontSize(): reference shared font grid; setCellSize(); publish font_grid message.
|   |   |-- setCellSize(): update metrics/padding; queueIo(resize); recomputeInitialSize(); notify UI.
|   |   `-- [async renderer wake] install new grid and release old reference -> Render/update/present loop.
|   |-- resize(): store screen size; balance padding; compute cell grid.
|   |   |-- queueIo(resize) -> IO command/event loop: coalesced PTY/terminal resize.
|   |   `-- [async renderer mailbox + wake] resize -> Render/update/present loop.
|   `-- colorSchemeCallback(): update conditional theme; notifyConfigConditionalState(); queue color_scheme_report.
|
|-- Change focus/visibility/display state [src/Surface.zig:2584,2590,3437,3466,3554]
|   |-- focusCallback(): update App focus; return if unchanged; publish renderer focus message.
|   |   |-- On focus loss: synthesize releases -> Accept keyboard/text: keyCallback().
|   |   `-- queueRender(); showMouse(); update terminal focus flag; queueIo(focused).
|   |-- occlusionCallback(): skip duplicate state; update terminal visibility flag.
|   |   `-- Queue visibility report when enabled; publish renderer visible message; queueRender().
|   |-- displayRealized(): Renderer.displayRealized(); make display available for rendering.
|   |-- displayUnrealized(): mark display unavailable; [async wake] renderer releases GPU resources.
|   `-- refreshCallback(): queueRender() -> Render/update/present loop.
|
|-- IO command/event loop: queueIo() and termio.Thread.threadMain() [src/Surface.zig:899; src/termio/Thread.zig:236]
|   |-- queueIo(msg): reject PTY writes in read-only mode; otherwise Termio.queueMessage().
|   |   `-- [async SPSC mailbox + notify] wakeupCallback() on IO thread.
|   |-- threadMain_(): Termio.threadEnter() -> Exec.threadEnter() [src/termio/Exec.zig:86]
|   |   |-- Subprocess.start(): open PTY; launch configured command with prepared environment.
|   |   |-- [async spawn] ReadThread.threadMainPosix/Windows() -> Receive/interpret PTY output.
|   |   |-- [async watchers] register process exit and periodic termios checks.
|   |   `-- Queue configured initial input; register mailbox wakeup and stop handlers.
|   |-- loop.run(.until_done): dispatch events until stop/error.
|   |   |-- Mailbox wakeup: drainMailbox(); pop messages until empty [src/termio/Thread.zig:289].
|   |   |   |-- write_*: Termio.queueWrite() -> Exec.queueWrite() [src/termio/Exec.zig:403]
|   |   |   |   `-- Ignore exited child; chunk bytes, optionally expand CR to CRLF.
|   |   |   |       `-- [async xev stream writes] ttyWrite() returns buffers to pool on completion.
|   |   |   |-- resize: handleResize(); save latest dimensions; [async timer] coalesceCallback().
|   |   |   |   `-- Termio.resize(): lock; resize PTY before Terminal.resize(); emit size report if enabled.
|   |   |   |       `-- [async renderer mailbox + wake] publish final size -> Render/update/present loop.
|   |   |   |-- change_config: Termio.changeConfig(); update parser/backend settings, colors, image limits.
|   |   |   |-- clear_screen/scroll_viewport/jump_to_prompt: mutate terminal screen or viewport.
|   |   |   |-- focused/visibility/color/size reports: inspect modes; encode applicable PTY reports.
|   |   |   |-- synchronized output: arm timeout; selection_scroll: start/stop selection timer.
|   |   |   `-- After nonempty drain: [async renderer wake] -> Render/update/present loop.
|   |   |-- Sync timeout: resetSynchronizedOutput(); release terminal update suppression.
|   |   |-- Selection timer: [async surface message] selection_scroll_tick -> UI message dispatch.
|   |   |-- Termios timer: inspect password-input state; [async surface message] notify changes.
|   |   |-- Process exit: processExitCommon(); mark exited; send exit code/runtime.
|   |   |   `-- [async surface message] child_exited -> UI message dispatch.
|   |   `-- Stop notification: stopCallback(); stop event loop.
|   `-- Deferred Termio.threadExit() -> Exec.threadExit(): stop subprocess; signal reader quit; join reader.
|
|-- Receive/interpret PTY output [src/termio/Exec.zig:1269,1430; src/termio/Termio.zig:705]
